title: Subcritical Hyperbolicity of Jensen Polynomials Associated with the Riemann Xi-Function
author: Wanzheng Ning
statusText: Submitted to the International Journal of Number Theory
summary: The submitted manuscript examines Jensen polynomials formed from Taylor coefficients of the Riemann xi-function. It presents a proof of a subcritical real-rootedness criterion for M = n + d at least C_epsilon times d^(3+epsilon), and explicitly leaves the endpoint scale M comparable to d^3 open.
